missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Пятно' is a neuter noun in the nominative case as the subject of 'появилось'. 'Большое' is the agreeing neuter adjective describing it.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Пятно' is the accusative direct object of 'заметил'. Neuter nouns keep the same form in the accusative, and 'странное' agrees in the neuter.
Strategic focus: Genitive with 'от'. 'Пятна' is the genitive form after 'от', expressing the source one wants rid of. 'Этого' is the agreeing neuter genitive demonstrative.

missions.phrase: К пятну на стене никто не прикасался.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative with 'к'. 'Пятну' is the dative form after 'к', marking what nobody touched. 'На стене' is the prepositional location of the mark.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'над'. 'Пятном' is the instrumental form after 'над' meaning above. 'Жёлтым' is the agreeing neuter instrumental adjective, and 'мухи' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'На пятне' uses the prepositional form 'пятне' after 'на' to mark location. 'След' is the nominative subject, and 'старый' agrees with it.

missions.phrase: Солнце спряталось за тёмным пятном облаков.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'за'. 'Пятном' is the instrumental form after 'за' meaning behind. 'Тёмным' agrees in the neuter, and 'облаков' is the genitive plural modifier.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural with a fleeting vowel. After 'много' the noun takes the genitive plural 'пятен', inserting a fleeting -е- in the consonant cluster. 'Жирных' is the agreeing plural adjective.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Пятна' is the nominative plural subject of 'плывут'. 'Белые' is the agreeing plural adjective, and 'по небу' marks the path.
Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Пятно' is nominative as the predicate noun. 'Маленькое' is the agreeing neuter adjective, softened by 'просто'. A clean descriptive model.
